Release notes

What changed in each test build we put on TestFlight before the public release, in plain words.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (15) · 2026-11-11

Build 15: Firefly Survivor

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • Firefly Survivor has arrived — a new game card on the hub, free and with no ads.
  • You can play it in all 11 languages.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (14) · 2026-11-07

Build 14: Pick up where you left off

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • Your progress, unlocks, settings, and idle realm now carry over to your other devices with the same Apple ID (when iCloud is on).
  • If iCloud is off, nothing happens and everything is simply saved on this device only.
  • If you played separately on two devices, the one that got further is kept, and unlocks are combined.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (13) · 2026-11-07

Build 13: Small touches

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • Tapping a game card, today's board, or the map banner on the hub now gives a light vibration (it stays off if you turn vibration off in Settings).
  • In the idle realm, tapping an upgrade you can't afford yet now answers with a dull sound and a vibration instead of doing nothing.
  • In landscape, the Land Hockey scoreboard now sits right next to the tall rink instead of far across the screen.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (12) · 2026-11-07

Build 12: Landscape, New Home, 11 Languages

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • You can now rotate the screen on iPad and iPhone. In landscape, the board sits on the left and the info on the right.
  • The home screen has a new look, with paper cards, icon tiles for choosing a game, and a start button that stays at the bottom.
  • The app is available in 11 languages.
  • Stamps now mark your wins in each game, and the game menu has a fresh design.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (11) · 2026-11-06

Build 11: Under the Hood

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • Parts shared across the app are now organized in one place. Nothing looks different.
  • Your saved settings carry over as they were.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (10) · 2026-11-06

Build 10: Fresh Art

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • Every game has a new look, with fresh art on the boards and pieces.
  • Wide screens such as iPad get a roomier layout.
  • Settings now show what changed in the parts shared across the app.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (9) · 2026-11-05

Build 9: Paint Conquest

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • New game: Paint Conquest. You and three computer players color a 16 by 22 board for 60 seconds.
  • Swipe across the board to turn, and grab stars for a boost.
  • Pick one of three difficulty levels in settings.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (8) · 2026-11-05

Build 8: Idle Estate

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • New game: Idle Estate. Your land grows by itself on an 11 by 11 board, and tapping a plot claims it faster.
  • Gold and forest plots are special land, and four upgrades speed things up.
  • When you come back, a message shows how much grew while you were away, up to 2 hours.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (7) · 2026-11-05

Build 7: Fence In

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • New game: Fence In. Drag across the board to shoot a wall, trap the drifter and fill the land.
  • A short tap switches the wall between horizontal and vertical.
  • Five stages, three lives and three difficulty levels.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (6) · 2026-11-05

Build 6: Turf Hockey

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • New game: Turf Hockey. Cells the puck crosses go to whoever hit it last.
  • A match lasts 60 seconds on a 12 by 20 board, and every goal leaves a stamp on the board.
  • A Classic switch in the settings sheet makes it first to 7 goals. The AI has three levels.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (5) · 2026-11-05

Build 5: Back to the hub, and a settings screen

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • Every game now has a menu: back to the hub, restart, and settings. Swiping back on iOS still works.
  • The new settings screen has switches for sound, vibration and color-blind patterns.
  • It also shows the app version and lets you reset your progress.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (4) · 2026-11-05

Build 4: Groundwork for a new game

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • No visible change in this build.
  • Behind the scenes, the rules and the AI opponents for Paint, a new game, were added. It is not playable yet, so its card still says Soon.

On TestFlight 1.0.0 (3) · 2026-11-05

Build 3: A new home screen

This build includes everything from the earlier builds, plus:

  • The first screen is now a game hub with a card for each of the seven games.
  • Today's Land and a map banner sit on the same screen.
  • Games that are not ready yet show a Soon label and a friendly message when tapped.

Last updated: 2026-11-11
